main.name: Adam Kent
main.description: Always striving to use the best and latest tools for the job.
main.bio: I'm a Full Stack Developer specialising in cloud-native architecture and AI/data driven systems. I've worked with organisations including EDF Energy, Novo Nordisk, Bank of America, and the UK Government. I'm also the editor of smartergovs.org, exploring the role of AI in public sector technology.
main.contactmessage: Please reach out via LinkedIn or the form below.

education.school: University of Liverpool & University of Leeds
education.description: Masters project: AI Classification of Music Genre - Built a Neural Network model classifying music genres using Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs).

work.title: Systems Development Engineer (InfraOps)
work.description: Building, configuring, and deploying specialist infrastructure. Following Google principles of Cloud-Native, SRE, and CI/CD.

work.title: Software Engineer
work.description: Working on Cloud-Native Python stacks using both Containers and Serverless. Using Design Patterns, Layered Architecture, and Domain-Driven-Design. DB and API Design (FastAPI), with Pydantic validation, and Alembic ORM. Making design decisions and rolling out features with product readiness in mind.

work.title: Software Engineer
work.description: Designed and deployed cloud-native AI-driven systems for EDF Energy, Centrica (British Gas), and Novo Nordisk. Delivered full-stack systems using Python (FastAPI, Flask), React, and Postgres. Built medical imaging tools and AI chat interfaces in production. Created CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure using Terraform and AWS CodePipeline. Built AI search tools using pre-trained models (huggingface), elasticsearch, and Neo4J.

work.title: Software Engineer II (AVP) - Commodities
work.description: Maintained Python risk platform (Brisk, part of Quartz/Athena) and designed PnL explain dashboards. Paired with front-office users for iterative improvements.

work.company: UK Government: Department of Health & SC
work.title: Data Scientist
work.description: Developed a Python-based informatics system for a new detection assay. Built secure dashboards and managed public health data pipelines. Advocated for scalable, transparent AI use in gov tech.
